data.current_description: Run payroll for one or more employees. Calculates all federal and state taxes with YTD tracking, creates a payroll record, and returns the payroll ID. Use notes='catch-up' for retroactive payrolls. Tip: use /payroll/preview first to validate your payload. Requires Starter+ subscription. Reciprocity attestations on the employee profile are honored automatically (work-state income tax suppressed; local taxes and SUI unaffected). Each employee carries `local_taxes_not_withheld`, the same list as on /payroll/preview, read from what the paycheck stored (`[]` for paychecks stored before 2026-10-06). Each employee also carries `time_off`, the same shape as on /payroll/preview, read from what the paycheck stored (`sick_leave` is unchanged).
data.description_suggestion: Run payroll for one or more employees, calculating all federal and state taxes with YTD tracking. Creates a persistent payroll record and returns the payroll ID. Accepts multiple employees in a single request. Use notes='catch-up' for retroactive payrolls. Requires Starter+ subscription. Reciprocity attestations on employee profiles are honored automatically (work-state income tax suppressed; local taxes and SUI unaffected). Response includes full tax breakdown, net pay, employer costs, local_taxes_not_withheld list, and time_off details for each employee. Tip: use /payroll/preview first to validate your payload before committing.
